question: Eight people (P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W) sit in two parallel rows containing four people each, facing each other. Row 1 faces South and contains P, Q, R, S. Row 2 faces North and contains T, U, V, W. Q sits opposite to U who is adjacent to T. P sits at an extreme end. R is adjacent to S and opposite to V. Who sits opposite to P?
